original_test_intent: Determine whether the platform remains bootable and manageable through warm and cold reboot when each approved noncritical storage filesystem reaches its defined full condition, without corrupting boot or protected data.
original_method: Unresolved. A safe method would require disposable serial/UUID-bound test filesystems or bounded files inside approved mountpoints, reserved control-plane space, explicit ENOSPC target, data backup, service-impact monitoring, ordered warm/cold reboots, integrity checks and deterministic cleanup; it must never stream zeros to raw devices or all discovered disks.
manual_activity: Storage owner must designate disposable media/filesystems and approve impact/recovery; operator controls cold power and recovery console.
safety_requirements: Never write raw block devices for filesystem fullness
Never enumerate all disks as write targets
Exclude boot, swap, RAID members and production data
Stop before service deadlock or corruption
No reboot until fill state is verified safe; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: After redesign, validate immutable targets and bounds
engineer_actions: Own backup, power/recovery and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Prohibited: it writes zeros directly to every discovered storage device and would destroy partition/filesystem/data structures.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until an approved non-destructive filesystem-level procedure exists; use serial/UUID-bound disposable mountpoints and bounded regular files only if authorized.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full-condition plus warm/cold reboot intent retained; destructive raw-device interpretation is not executable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use dedicated disposable test volumes with bounded file allocation, preserved control-plane reserve, ENOSPC evidence, reboot/integrity checkpoints and guaranteed cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates raw writes and unconstrained all-disk selection while retaining the intended capacity-pressure/reboot behavior.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single scratch volume would not cover 'all available' until the approved project target matrix defines that phrase; raw overwrite is not valid coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Full filesystems can break logging/services, and cold reboot can amplify corruption; raw-device dd guarantees data destruction rather than testing filesystem fullness.

project_override_considerations: Owner must decide whether every E1.S/NVMe filesystem, only data volumes, or one representative disposable volume is required and whether Iometer is actually part of the authoritative method.
expected_evidence: Bounded allocation commands and ENOSPC/threshold evidence

review_improvement: Stops a catastrophic raw all-disk overwrite while preserving the capacity-pressure and reboot-resilience intent for a safe redesign.
independent_technical_reasoning: Writing to `/dev/nvme*` or `/dev/sd*` tests media overwrite, not filesystem fullness, and destroys metadata before `df` can show the intended state. Even regular-file filling needs root/log reserve because the ability to reboot may otherwise be confounded by control-plane starvation rather than storage robustness.
